def analyse(corpus, sites_name, src, out_name, min_sites=3, external_only=False, thresh=None):

        if isinstance(v['notableInherited'], dict):
            vis |= set(v['notableInherited'].keys())
        else:
            vis |= set(v['notableInherited'] or [])
        visible[k] = vis
        ly = {}
        for l in v['inheritance']:
            lab = f"{l['typeName']}<{l.get('htmlElement') or '-'}>"
            om = l.get('omitted')
            names = d['nameLists'].get(om, []) if om else []

    srcabs = BASE + src

    for k, ss in bycomp.items():

        cnt = collections.Counter()
        spreads = 0
        for s in ss:
            for a in set(s['attrs']):

            spreads += 1 if s['spreads'] else 0
        passed = set(cnt)

# Relevance baseline: do the default outputs show the props consumers pass? (trail 405, track T5)

Read-only measurement. Binary: release build of origin/main 7b8f6d0d (rust 1.99.1), target dir `shrink/target-relevance`. No PR, no push, no oracle run.
Scripts: `shrink/relevance/` (`run-extract.sh`, `run-all.sh`, `callsites.mjs`, `elemprops.mjs`, `gen-elemprops.py`, `analyze.py`). Raw outputs in `shrink/relevance/out/`; the full per-corpus, per-variant numbers (including "outside library src only" and thresholded rules) are in `shrink/relevance/results.md`. Re-run: `run-all.sh`, `run-callsites.sh`, `gen-elemprops.py`, `analyze.py`.

## Method

- Extraction: `extract --json --quiet --no-cache` with defaults (`--collapse-inherited-props dependencies`, `--html-attributes full`), with the checker and with `--no-checker`, on mantine `packages/@mantine/core/src`, react-spectrum `packages`, shadcn-ui `apps/v4`, ant-design `components`. Chakra: `packages/react/src` with `--no-checker` only (never run with the checker). Peak RSS of every run was 0.1 to 1.0 GiB, one process at a time.
- Call sites: TypeScript compiler API walk of every .tsx/.jsx in the whole checkout (skipping node_modules, dist, build). A capitalised JSX tag is resolved syntactically by import/export identity: TS module resolution with the nearest tsconfig (paths), a workspace-package fallback (package.json name to dir/src/index), then re-export chains (`export {a as b} from`, `export *`, `export default X`, local aliases) are followed to a (file, exportName) position. Dotted tags (`Accordion.Item`) are resolved through `X.Item = Y` and `Object.assign(X, {Item: Y})`. The position is matched to caliper's `exports` (file + export name), never by display name. Attribute names only; spreads counted separately and their keys ignored; `key` dropped, `ref` kept.
- `passed` = union of attribute names over the component's call sites; components need >= 3 call sites. `visible` = names in the component's prop sets + `notableInherited` (empty everywhere in these runs). `hidden` = passed, not visible, and in a collapsed inheritance layer. A layer's names are its `members` list when the output has one; otherwise (the layer has `htmlElement` and no member names, which is the case for the `React.ComponentProps<"el">` layers) the names are the props of `JSX.IntrinsicElements["el"]` read from the same @types/react the run loaded (`elemprops.mjs`). That is an assumption: the output itself does not name them (see "What the output lacks"). "Passed but in no list" = neither visible nor in any layer.
- Coverage = |passed ∩ visible| / |passed| per component. Medians are over components.

## Headline numbers, default output (collapsed layers), checker, all call sites

- mantine: 194 components measured. Visible per component median 77, p90 106. Coverage median 1.00, mean 0.86 (53% of components at 100%). Used-but-hidden: mean 0.87 per component, median 0, p90 3, max 13; 169 (component, prop) pairs; 49% strict DOM/ARIA (className, style, id, aria-*, data-*, on*), 84% broad (adds placeholder, value, disabled, role, tabIndex, type, readOnly ...). Top: placeholder 15, id 14, aria-label 12, ref 11, value 11, onClick 9, onChange 9, readOnly 9, disabled 8, role 5, onFocus 4, onKeyDown 4, onMouseLeave 4, tabIndex 4, onMouseDown 3 (components; layers are `React.ComponentProps<input|div|button>`).
- react-spectrum: 255 measured. Visible median 74, p90 113. Coverage median 1.00, mean 0.96 (85% at 100%). Hidden mean 0.05, 98% of components have none; 12 pairs (50% strict, 92% broad): style 3, ref 3, className 3, slot 2, inert 1 (layer `HTMLAttributes<div>`).
- shadcn-ui: 408 measured. Visible median 3, p90 81. Coverage median 0.50, mean 0.43 (27% at 100%). Hidden mean 0.99, median 1, p90 2, max 8; 404 pairs, 76% strict, 95% broad. Top: className 243 components, id 26, aria-label 13, style 12, placeholder 12, type 11, disabled 10, defaultValue 9, onClick 8, htmlFor 8, title 6, ref 6, src 4, alt 4, value 4 (layers `React.ComponentProps<button|div|input|svg>`).
- ant-design: 47 measured. Visible median 17, p90 61. Coverage median 1.00, mean 0.91 (74% at 100%). Hidden mean 0.74, median 0, p90 2, max 8; 35 pairs, 66% strict, 100% broad. Top: className 6, style 6, ref 5, onClick 4, target 2, rel 2 (`React.HTMLAttributes<div>`, `AnchorHTMLAttributes<a>`).

## `--no-checker` output (structural resolver)

The structural resolver does not collapse the HTML attributes here: it lists them, so nothing is hidden and the cost is rows instead.
- mantine: 194 measured, visible median 352.5, p90 389; coverage mean 0.94; hidden 0.
- react-spectrum: 255; visible median 51, p90 123; coverage mean 0.91; hidden mean 0.01 (2 pairs, `ref`).
- shadcn-ui: 408; visible median 281, p90 294; coverage mean 0.94; hidden 0.
- ant-design: 47; visible median 40, p90 305; coverage mean 1.00; hidden 0.
- chakra (`--no-checker` only): 59 measured; visible median 1123, p90 1137; coverage mean 0.97; hidden mean 0.03 (2 pairs, `ref`, layer `ComponentPropsWithoutRef<span>`). 3792 call sites matched among 629 components.
- The residual misses under `--no-checker` are props in no list: mantine 1.75 per component (onClick 13, href 12, target 9, aria-label 9, ref 8: props that arrive through Mantine's polymorphic `component`/`renderRoot`), shadcn `data-slot` 43 and `data-sidebar` 16 (data-* attributes are in no list in either mode), chakra `data-testid`.

## What a rule "show the props consumers pass" would add and cost

- Extra rows = used-but-hidden props per measured component (checker output). Mean: mantine 0.87, spectrum 0.05, shadcn 0.99, antd 0.74. Median 0, 0, 1, 0; p90 3, 0, 2, 2; max 13, 5, 8, 8. Gain: shadcn coverage median 0.50 to 1.00 and mean 0.43 to about 1.0; mantine mean 0.86 to about 0.99 (the rest is the props in no list). Nearly all of the added rows are DOM/ARIA attributes, so the rule is mostly "surface className, id, aria-label, onClick, style, placeholder, type, disabled, value".
- With a frequency floor (props passed at >= max(2, 20% of sites)) the cost drops to mean 0.30 (mantine), 0.03 (spectrum), 0.76 (shadcn), 0.24 (antd) extra rows, p90 1; with a 50% floor 0.26, 0.01, 0.60, 0.12. Shadcn's median coverage stays 0.50 at the 20% floor and reaches 1.00 at 50%, which says the unmet shadcn demand is concentrated in one prop: className accounts for 243 of the 404 hidden-used pairs.
- So the rule is cheap on rows (about 1 row per component, versus 74 to 350 visible rows today) but it needs call-site data the extractor does not have: the signal comes from a consumer corpus, not from the library source. Without that data a static stand-in is the fixed set {className, style, id, aria-*, data-*, ref} plus handlers, which would be the same 1 to 3 rows. Expanding all layers instead costs 280 to 1100 rows per component, as the `--no-checker` numbers show.

## What the output lacks (found while measuring)

- Collapsed layers `React.ComponentProps<"el">` and `HTMLAttributes<el>` carry `htmlElement` and `omitted`, but `members` is empty and `totalProps` is 0 (mantine: all 255 layers; shadcn: 1299 of 1417). A reader of the JSON cannot tell which attributes are inside. Only 106 layers (e.g. `GlobalDOMEvents`) carry a member list. My "hidden" set therefore relies on @types/react; if the layer's real contents differ (for instance `Omit`), the hidden counts move. The "no list at all" figures are the upper bound of what an extractor-side fix would not recover.
- mantine Button (checker and no-checker): 85 props, no inheritance layer, no onClick/href: HTML attributes are in no list at all (`passed but in no list` above).

## Limits, candidly

- Call sites inside the library itself count as consumers in the headline numbers (docs, tests excluded only where the corpus was pruned). `results.md` has the "outside library src only" variant: mantine 176 components, coverage mean 0.88, hidden mean 0.68; react-spectrum only 29 components (corpus is `packages` only, 484 external sites; hidden mean 0.14); ant-design 29, hidden mean 0.72; chakra 55, hidden mean 0.04. For shadcn `apps/v4` is the whole app, so inside and outside cannot be separated (0 sites outside).
- Spread attributes: call sites with at least one spread, averaged over components: mantine 19%, spectrum 34%, shadcn 3%, antd 17%, chakra 5%. Props passed only through spreads are invisible to this oracle, so true coverage demand is understated, most for spectrum.
- Wrappers: a component re-exported through a wrapper that is itself a caliper component (a design-system layer over a primitive) is counted at the wrapper only; what the wrapper forwards is not seen. Unresolved tags: external packages not in the checkout (mantine 769, spectrum 3412, shadcn 3432, antd 474, chakra 1322) and local non-exported bindings (432, 766, 497, 176, 479) are not counted; so spectrum's matched sites are 2761 of 9692 capitalised tags. Dotted members that are not defined by `X.Y = Z` or `Object.assign` are not matched.
- `passed` is a union across call sites (one use is enough), so it overstates demand for rare props; the 20%/50% rows give the frequency-weighted view, and `results.md` also lists call-weighted coverage (median 1.00 everywhere except shadcn 0.50).
- Stories: the checkouts are mostly pruned but two corpora still hold story files. react-spectrum has 132 story files, 25 with `args` (47 distinct keys, e.g. `placeholder`, `onSelectionChange`); chakra has 125 under `__stories__`, only 1 with a `component` meta and `args` (`children`, `variant`). Mantine, shadcn, antd: none. Stories were scanned but not folded into the coverage numbers (too few).
- Chakra: no checker run, as instructed. `checker-default/chakra-only/src` was extracted with and without the checker (688 MiB peak with the checker), but its files are synthetic re-exports of the installed package, so no call site in the Chakra checkout maps to them; it is not included in any figure.
- One snapshot of one commit per corpus, one hidden-set assumption (above), and a syntactic resolver rather than the full checker: an unresolved import silently lowers the component count, never raises coverage.

Read-only measurement. Binary: release build of origin/main 7b8f6d0d (rust 1.99.1), target dir `shrink/target-relevance`. No PR, no push, no oracle run.
Scripts: `shrink/relevance/` (`run-extract.sh`, `run-all.sh`, `callsites.mjs`, `elemprops.mjs`, `gen-elemprops.py`, `analyze.py`). Raw outputs in `shrink/relevance/out/`; the full per-corpus, per-variant numbers (including "outside library src only" and thresholded rules) are in `shrink/relevance/results.md`. Re-run: `run-all.sh`, `run-callsites.sh`, `gen-elemprops.py`, `analyze.py`.

- Call sites: TypeScript compiler API walk of every .tsx/.jsx in the whole checkout (skipping node_modules, dist, build). A capitalised JSX tag is resolved syntactically by import/export identity: TS module resolution with the nearest tsconfig (paths), a workspace-package fallback (package.json name to dir/src/index), then re-export chains (`export {a as b} from`, `export *`, `export default X`, local aliases) are followed to a (file, exportName) position. Dotted tags (`Accordion.Item`) are resolved through `X.Item = Y` and `Object.assign(X, {Item: Y})`. The position is matched to caliper's `exports` (file + export name), never by display name. Attribute names only; spreads counted separately and their keys ignored; `key` dropped, `ref` kept.
- `passed` = union of attribute names over the component's call sites; components need >= 3 call sites. `visible` = names in the component's prop sets + `notableInherited` (empty everywhere in these runs). `hidden` = passed, not visible, and in a collapsed inheritance layer. A layer's names are its `members` list when the output has one; otherwise (the layer has `htmlElement` and no member names, which is the case for the `React.ComponentProps<"el">` layers) the names are the props of `JSX.IntrinsicElements["el"]` read from the same @types/react the run loaded (`elemprops.mjs`). - react-spectrum: 255 measured. Visible median 74, p90 113. Coverage median 1.00, mean 0.96 (85% at 100%). Hidden mean 0.05, 98% of components have none; 12 pairs (50% strict, 92% broad): style 3, ref 3, className 3, slot 2, inert 1 (layer `HTMLAttributes<div>`).
- shadcn-ui: 408 measured. Visible median 3, p90 81. Coverage median 0.50, mean 0.43 (27% at 100%). Hidden mean 0.99, median 1, p90 2, max 8; 404 pairs, 76% strict, 95% broad. - ant-design: 47 measured. Visible median 17, p90 61. Coverage median 1.00, mean 0.91 (74% at 100%). Hidden mean 0.74, median 0, p90 2, max 8; 35 pairs, 66% strict, 100% broad. Top: className 6, style 6, ref 5, onClick 4, target 2, rel 2 (`React.HTMLAttributes<div>`, `AnchorHTMLAttributes<a>`).

- Extra rows = used-but-hidden props per measured component (checker output). Mean: mantine 0.87, spectrum 0.05, shadcn 0.99, antd 0.74. Median 0, 0, 1, 0; p90 3, 0, 2, 2; max 13, 5, 8, 8.
